name: scical600
description: An independent browser and native scientific calculator platform.

scripts.brand:check: npm run build && node scripts/check-brand-independence.mjs dist && node scripts/check-dependency-licenses.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:main && npm run deploy:lmc && npm run deploy:systembussing
scripts.deploy:main: npx --yes wrangler@latest pages deploy dist --project-name scical600 --branch main
scripts.deploy:lmc: npx --yes wrangler@latest pages deploy dist/lmc --project-name scical600 --branch lmc
scripts.deploy:systembussing: npx --yes wrangler@latest pages deploy dist/systembussing --project-name scical600 --branch systembussing
